checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Bottle is forest green and matte
must.why: Matte green, though lighter and brighter than a deep forest green.

must.item: Bottle retains exact silhouette, position, surface details
must.why: Silhouette and position match; the cap loop opening was slightly redrawn, and the bottom seam is a bit different.
They look the same at a glance; the table grain looks slightly redrawn and sharper.

must.item: No visible alterations outside mask at matching resolution
must.why: No pixel diff available. The table grain looks subtly regenerated, but I saw no obvious changes.

must.item: No green spill, halo, crop or framing shift
must.why: No visible spill or halo, and the framing is the same.

faults.what: Green is a mid or leaf green, lighter and more saturated than forest green.
Bottle looks flatter and has less tonal depth, and its reflections are weaker than the original.
Cap loop detail is slightly altered, and the table grain looks slightly regenerated.

summary: The bottle is now a matte green with the scene preserved, but the green is lighter than true forest green and the bottle looks slightly flat.
